title: Owner unread notifications and Slack-style channel indicators
summary: Implementation committed as 63edbe5 with server/client changes and a real-route separation/durability integration test. Thread reports say focused server/client tests, typecheck, invariant checks and desktop/phone screenshots passed. However, the screenshots did not use the live endpoint: at the time /api/buddies/channels/unread returned 404 because the backend had not reloaded. The canonical feature task remains in review; its next action is live cross-device verification after reload. The broader reload task remains open. Explicit limits: owner @mentions are unavailable to count, read marks are channel-level, and posts before initialization are not counted.
nextAction: Product Development Lead: after a safe backend reload, verify GET /api/buddies/channels/unread returns real counts; run pnpm screenshots --only home,channel,thread against real API data; open a channel on desktop and confirm it clears on phone; confirm a Buddy's get_list unread count is unchanged. Then update the feature task evidence/status and resolve its stated scope limits with the owner if needed.
evidence: Thread report: commit 63edbe5; 20/20 server channel tests, 168/168 client tests, typecheck and invariant gates passed; screenshots used computed counts injected into the page because the live endpoint returned 404.

Current task buddy_project_cbd6043b-848b-4741-ae0f-d4a54f03688c is in review, owned by buddy_e0527b5c-e467-45b7-b5fe-0265c51402b4; next action is cross-device clearing and Buddy unread invariance after backend reload.

Current task buddy_project_d6b661c3-8250-4d45-a4aa-07c4874392ab is open; its comment adds the unread endpoint, real-data screenshots, cross-device clear and Buddy unread checks to reload verification.

Read-only repository inspection: commit 63edbe5 contains server routes, owner read store, desktop/mobile UI and integration test; current HEAD is b39dca3, so it is an ancestor. Working tree is dirty in overlapping ChannelBrowser.tsx, ChannelsMobile.tsx and related files; no conclusion is drawn from those later changes.
limitations: No tests were run and no backend restart/live endpoint call was performed for this audit. The working tree is broadly dirty, including overlapping feature files, so commit 63edbe5 was reviewed directly. Tasks snapshot search was inconclusive; current Tasks were fetched directly.
